§3§lChoose what you need§r
For wireless machine power, follow the Link Terminal and energy/power cover branch. For grid and machine status, follow the monitor, Portable Monitor, info panel and Device Info Terminal branches. For wireless ME connections, follow the Quantum Terminal, nodes and incorporation anchors. Once sources are configured, Factory Mode and the dashboard bring their information together.

§3§lFollow the branches§r
This chapter contains §122§r quests. Start with A Terminal at Your Fingertips for the wheel, then choose the Factory Mode or dashboard route. Lose the Terminal, Keep the Profile introduces data recovery, followed by sharing and continuous monitoring. Learn the machine, panel, power and quantum branches as needed, and prepare their items before trying their operations.

§3§lRemember the entrances§r
Defaults are §1C§r for the terminal wheel, §1H§r for the Portable Monitor viewer, §1F12§r for Factory Mode and §1F10§r for the dashboard. Bindings can be changed; follow current hints. The wheel uses terminals equipped in Baubles, while each other tutorial explains its own preparation.

§3§lPreparation and completion§r
Keep source chunks loaded, and provide valid AE power and channels for ME features. Tick tutorial quests after understanding or trying the steps; crafting and item checks follow their stated requirements. Tick this overview after reading.
